name: Montorsi 1997
question: Does early intracavernous alprostadil after nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy improve recovery of spontaneous intercourse-sufficient erections compared with observation?

arms.label: Intracavernous alprostadil three times weekly for 12 weeks

design.population: Thirty preoperatively potent men with clinical stage B1 or B2 prostate cancer, Gleason sum at least 7, and PSA under 20 ng/mL underwent nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy.

verdictNote: Efficacy compared 12 injection completers with all 15 controls.
takeaway: After nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy, intracavernous alprostadil three times weekly for 12 weeks increased reported spontaneous intercourse-sufficient erections at six months versus observation: 8/12 treatment completers (67%) versus 3/15 controls (20%; P < 0.01).

reports.label: Initial report
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation and Crossref publication month: October 1997; day not specified
reports.citation: Montorsi F, Guazzoni G, Strambi LF, et al. "Recovery of spontaneous erectile function after nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy with and without early intracavernous injections of alprostadil: results of a prospective, randomized trial." *J Urol.* 1997;158(4):1408-1410. doi:10.1016/S0022-5347(01)64227-7

results.measure: Patient-reported spontaneous erection sufficient for satisfactory sexual intercourse at six months
results.note: The abstract calls the difference statistically significant but does not state a prespecified alpha; experimental efficacy excludes three noncompleters.

results.endpoint: Physiologic findings among men reporting recovered erections
results.measure: Normal nocturnal erection testing and penile Doppler hemodynamics among responders

values.exp: 7/8 normal nocturnal testing; 8/8 normal Doppler hemodynamics
values.ctl: 3/3 normal nocturnal testing and Doppler hemodynamics

results.note: Responder-only testing; not a comparison of randomized groups.

harms.label: Penile nodule
harms.note: The abstract reports 13% for the injection arm.

harms.label: Prolonged penile erection
harms.note: The abstract prints 6%; 1/15 recalculates to 6.7%. Duration and management are not stated.

delivery.label: Injection schedule
delivery.value: Intracavernous alprostadil three times weekly for 12 weeks after surgery.
